item.title: [7.1] Global Market: Euro zone bond yields hover near 15-year highs as Middle East war fuels inflation fears
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Euro zone bond yields stayed near 15-year highs as Middle East conflict-driven energy inflation raised expectations for ECB rate hikes. item.description:
